text: Missher DSH Reasoning Effort 为 DSH Web 提供对话模型选择和思考深度滑块，滑块根据当前模型声明的推理档位映射选择值。自定义模型缺少档位信息或与内置参考不一致时，可查看配置指引并复制建议片段；支持的宿主还可在模型卡片中设置档位模式和上限。适合需要按模型能力调节推理强度的 DSH 用户。

Missher DSH Reasoning Effort adds model selection and a reasoning slider to DSH Web. The slider follows each model’s declared effort levels. For custom models missing levels, users can view and copy configuration guidance. Compatible hosts add per-model effort controls for adjusting reasoning depth.
想在 DSH 对话里用滑块调节模型的思考强度。
不同模型支持的推理档位不一样，能按各自声明来选择吗？
自定义模型没有推理档位配置时，怎么查看应该补什么？
我希望在模型设置卡片里配置推理模式和最高档位。
Can I adjust a model’s reasoning effort from the conversation model control?
Help me see a configuration suggestion when a custom model has no declared effort levels.
Missher DSH Reasoning Effort 的功能「推理深度滑块」：在对话模型入口按当前模型的推理档位显示滑块；不足两个档位时不显示，并将非原生刻度映射到模型提供的最近档位。
Missher DSH Reasoning Effort 的功能「自定义模型档位指引」：检测已声明自定义模型缺失或不匹配的档位后，展示配置路径和建议片段；用户可复制内容，自行按宿主流程修改。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Missher DSH Reasoning Effort：模型选择、按模型已声明能力映射的思考深度滑块，以及自定义模型的档位配置指引。包名为 `@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort`。[下载 1.0.0 安装包](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort/releases/download/v1.0.0/missher-dsh-reasoning-effort-1.0.0.tgz)。

[English](README.en.md) · [桌面端与安装包](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DeepseekHarness-Desktop) · [源码](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort) · [反馈](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort/issues)

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 功能：- 在对话模型入口选择模型、调整思考深度；显示阶梯映射到模型实际声明的档位，选择失败会回退。至少两个可用档位才显示滑块。
- 单层卡片、白色滑块和最高档点阵；保持已选定的八行粒子设计、渐变配色、深浅主题与中英文。颜色仅在“设置 → 通用设置 → 思考滑块配色”调整。减少动态效果时显示稳定帧，页面隐藏时暂停粒子。
- 自定义模型缺失档位或声明与内置参考不符时，显示配置片段及“复制给 Agent”。标题保持完整，复制按钮同宽同高，正文独立滚动，操作区保持可见；极矮窗口将正文与操作一起滚动，标题不参与滚动。窗口缩放时跟随宿主布局重新定位，避免弹窗越出屏幕。
- **每模型推理档位只走宿主声明的行内入口**：配套 Missher Desktop 的 Models 模块声明 `settings.models.model-fields` 时，思考模式和最高档位显示在模型卡片右侧，共用该卡片的保存操作。宿主不声明该 slot 时（官方 DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` 即如此），保持原生模型选择、滑块与指引，**不再提供插件私有设置页**（0.7.8 移除 0.7.7 的设置页回退）。行内控件沿用模型已声明的端点映射，插件不会按档位名猜取值。插件本身不增加文本/图片能力，也不另存模型目录。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 宿主要求与验证范围：按实际接口判断兼容性：需要模型目录、会话选模、Slots、Locale 和设置服务。Host 必须提供 `settings.describe`、`settings.prepareDocument`、`llm.resolveModelInfo`；缺失时给出具体诊断。设置命名空间和指引通道按能力启用；通道必须同时具备路由注册和请求校验能力。

DSH peer 保持 `*`；Cordis 支持 `^4.0.4 || ^4.0.5-alpha.1`，Schemastery 支持 `^3.18.4 || ^3.18.5-alpha.1`，React 为 `^18.2.0`。开发 SDK 保持 `0.2.0-rc.2`。版本范围表示安装准入，实际验证范围如下。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 宿主要求与验证范围：| 宿主 | 0.7.6 验证范围 |
| --- | --- |
| 官方 npm DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5` / Cordis `4.0.5` | 隔离 Web profile、实际 Loader、请求校验、只读指引、客户端加载与卸载；真实浏览器检查滑块、复制、配色和宽窄窗口。使用合成模型数据。 |
| Missher 社区扩展 `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` | 实际隔离 Host 启动、Loader、指引、请求校验、客户端字节与卸载检查；不等同于原版官方发行包认证。 |
| macOS、Windows 原生桌面及其他宿主版本 | 本次未新增原生验收。历史安装记录及详细边界见 [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md)。 |

模型行扩展是可选能力，缺失时等待声明，声明到达或撤销时同步注册和清理，滑块仍可用。本包不包含宿主模块副本。上述验证未向真实模型端点发起推理请求。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 宿主要求与验证范围：`0.7.7` 在 `0.7.6` 之上只增加“宿主不声明 `settings.models.model-fields` 时的设置页入口”，写回的仍是宿主同一份 `reasoningEfforts` 配置：只写精确叶节点并保留其它字段；写入前由宿主公开的 `settingsSchema` 解析该叶并校验取值；用户层重复 id、路径不明确、文档只读或叶不可证时保持只读；内置模型只有在路由未自声明 models 列表、且 id 属于已安装目录时才使用 `modelOverrides`，继承值取自 base 层。

`0.7.7` 已通过类型检查、构建、103 项模型档位行为检查和 29 项配色浏览器检查。官方 npm DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` 的隔离 Web profile 已实际验证设置页、显式映射、无效值禁止保存、保存后重开与刷新、相邻模型保持不变，以及两次宿主修改时的草稿冲突保留；修正后的正常宽度和 390 像素窗口均已测量并查看真实截图。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 宿主要求与验证范围：这是分阶段合并覆盖：最终 CSS 调整后重验受影响的客户端类型、构建、加载与页面布局；103 项逻辑、29 项配色、保存与冲突处理，以及未变的后端、双语文案和前五组逻辑套件复用本候选此前通过的结果，不代表同一轮全量重跑。另有 50 项生命周期检查使用实际 rc.4 Cordis/模块系统/SlotRegistry 和候选插件工厂，但声明变化与非 slot 服务为受控夹具，不等于社区宿主行内保存的端到端验收。

**0.7.7 已正式发布。**上述使用合成模型的 Web 验证不等于原生 Electron、macOS、Windows 或真实模型端点验收；上表保留独立的 0.7.6 历史范围。失败记录、复用来源与限制见 [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md)。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 宿主要求与验证范围：`0.7.8` 移除了 0.7.7 的独立设置页。支持 `settings.models.model-fields` 的宿主在模型卡片内显示档位设置。类型检查、构建和 103 项模型档位行为检查已在本机复跑通过。[0.7.7 旧版页面截图](docs/images/reasoning-model-settings-rc4.png)。

`1.0.0` 将指引框固定为常规 312 × 360 像素，展开、长文本和复制反馈不再撑大外框；小窗口按可用空间缩小并在内部滚动。复制给 Agent 的内容保留配置位置、端点核实规则和建议片段，删除重复背景与教程。旧独立设置页专用逻辑、文案和测试已移除。
@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 界面：下方两张滑块和配色截图来自插件 0.7.6，使用官方 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5` 的隔离 Web profile 和合成模型。[截图说明](docs/images/README.md)。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 固定版本安装：以下桌面端和 CLI 安装地址均固定为 `1.0.0`。同次发布的 `SHA256SUMS` 可用于校验安装包。[GitHub 发布页](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort/releases/tag/v1.0.0)。

**桌面端：**在“插件 → 添加插件”填写以下固定地址，核对版本、启用状态和加载错误，然后按宿主提示重新加载或重启。Desktop 的配置由桌面插件管理器维护，不用独立 CLI 的 `web` profile 代替。

```text
https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort/releases/download/v1.0.0/missher-dsh-reasoning-effort-1.0.0.tgz
```

**独立 Web/CLI profile：**已安装 DSH CLI 的用户可运行：

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 固定版本安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort/releases/download/v1.0.0/missher-dsh-reasoning-effort-1.0.0.tgz
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

将 `web` 换成自己实际使用的 Web/CLI profile。配置应包含 `id: reasoning-effort`、`name: '@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort'`；仅出现在配置中不代表 Loader 已激活。然后启动或重启该 profile，打开对话模型入口检查。不要同时启用旧上游包与本定制包，它们使用相同的指引通道和设置键。

更新前保留旧 tarball 和当前 profile 配置。tarball 是固定快照，Git 拉取不会自动更新日常安装。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 使用与模型能力：滑块读取模型目录的 `reasoning.efforts`。最高支持档位、默认档位与当前会话选中档位各有含义；显示为 Ultra 或最高点阵不会产生额外能力。降低再提高模型配置上限不会丢失草稿中已有映射，稀疏档位保留端点实际值，无法识别映射时保持自动模式。

自定义模型缺失声明时，打开“查看档位声明指引”，根据当前配置文件路径及端点文档，编辑 `llm-pi-ai` 的对应模型条目，例如：

```yaml
reasoningEfforts:
  low: "<端点接受的较低强度值>"
  high: "<端点接受的较高强度值>"
```

未列出的档位不声明为可选。`reasoningEfforts: false` 表示不提供可选强度档位，不能保证端点内部完全不思考。对既有目录模型的单项覆盖使用 `modelOverrides`；不要无意用非空 `models` 列表替换整个提供方目录。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 使用与模型能力：仅在端点文档或具体错误支持时添加 `compat`，如 `thinkingFormat`、`supportsReasoningEffort`、`supportsDeveloperRole` 或 `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages`。内置知识条目仅供参考，不是供应商承诺。滑块出现只证明目录与界面识别成功；请求参数是否被服务端接受仍需验证。

“复制给 Agent”将当前模型标识、实际配置路径、诊断与建议片段放入剪贴板，不会自动调用其他 Agent 或提交修改。Host 指引只读；模型行编辑须使用宿主原有保存操作。可通过插件配置 `entries` 补充自己的知识条目，详见 [中文配置教程](src/client/agent-tutorial.zh.md)及 [Host 配置定义](src/index.ts)。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 启停、卸载与数据保留：- 临时恢复原生模型选择器：关闭“设置 → 通用设置 → 推理强度滑块”。该开关只控制滑块入口；停用整个插件请在插件管理器禁用对应 Bundle。
- 桌面端通过同一插件管理器卸载 `@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort`；Web/CLI profile 使用下面的准确包名，再重启或刷新宿主。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @missher/dsh-reasoning-effort
```

插件没有聊天或学习数据库。卸载不主动删除宿主的会话、凭据、模型声明或其他插件数据；已保存的模型设置仍属于宿主。插件不主动清除浏览器偏好 `dsh-reasoning-effort.enabled`、`dsh-reasoning-effort.palette`（兼容读取旧 enabled 键），停用后重启可恢复原生入口。自定义 `entries` 和 profile 覆盖在卸载前自行备份；是否清理由宿主卸载流程决定，不要为重置外观删除整个 profile。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · 开发与许可：使用 Node.js `22.19+`、pnpm `11.7.0`；在隔离目录构建，顺序执行 `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`、`pnpm run check`、`pnpm test`、`pnpm pack`。测试套件串行执行。具体见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，验证分层见 [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md)，安全反馈见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。[设计预览](design/depth-slider/README.md)的控件仅用于演示，日常颜色入口仍在设置页。

基于 HanaAyane 的上游 `dsh-reasoning-effort`，保留 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)与作者署名；点阵引擎改编自 MEMZ-鱼子酱的设计并保留其 [MIT 声明](THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE.txt)。来源和定制边界见 [FORK.md](FORK.md)。

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Missher DSH Reasoning Effort：Model selection, a thinking-depth slider mapped to declared model capabilities, and configuration guidance for custom models. The package name is `@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort`. [Download the 1.0.0 plugin](https://github.com/Missher12/Missher-DSH-Reasoning-Effort/releases/download/v1.0.0/missher-dsh-reasoning-effort-1.0.0.tgz).

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Features：- Choose a model and adjust thinking depth from the conversation model control. Displayed steps map to the model's declared levels; failed selections roll back. The slider requires at least two available levels.
- Preserve the selected single-card design, white thumb, eight-row particle field at the highest level, colour gradient, light/dark themes and Chinese/English UI. Colours live in General Settings. Reduced-motion mode shows a stable frame; hidden pages pause particles.
- For custom models with missing or mismatched declarations, show configuration guidance and Copy for your agent. The heading stays fully visible, copy buttons have equal dimensions, and the body scrolls independently of the actions; very short menus scroll the body and actions together below the heading. Open menus follow the Host layout during window resizing to stay within the viewport.
- **Per-model reasoning levels use only the Host-declared inline entry:** when the companion Missher Desktop Models module declares `settings.models.model-fields`, reasoning mode and maximum level appear beside the model card and share its save action. When the Host does not de

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：Compatibility follows the interfaces available at runtime. The client needs the model directory, session selection, Slots, Locale and settings services. The Host requires `settings.describe`, `settings.prepareDocument` and `llm.resolveModelInfo`; missing members produce specific diagnostics. The settings namespace and guidance channel are optional capabilities. The channel needs both route registration and request validation.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：DSH peers remain `*`; Cordis accepts `^4.0.4 || ^4.0.5-alpha.1`, Schemastery `^3.18.4 || ^3.18.5-alpha.1`, and React `^18.2.0`. The development SDK remains `0.2.0-rc.2`. These ranges allow installation; verified coverage is narrower:

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：| Host | 0.7.6 evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Official npm DSH `0.2.1-alpha.5` / Cordis `4.0.5` | Isolated Web profile, actual Loader, request validation, read-only guidance, served client and unloading; real-browser slider, clipboard, palette and viewport checks with synthetic models. |
| Missher community extensions `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-alpha.2` | Actual isolated Host boot, Loader, guidance, request validation, client-byte and unload checks. These are not pristine official distributions. |
| Native macOS/Windows Desktop and other Host versions | No new native acceptance in this delivery. Historical evidence and detailed limits are in [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md). |

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：The model-row extension is optional. Registration follows its declaration and removal while the slider remains available. This Bundle embeds no Host modules. These checks made no inference calls to real model endpoints.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：`0.7.7` adds only the settings-page entry point for hosts that do not declare `settings.models.model-fields`. It writes the same Host `reasoningEfforts` configuration: one exact leaf, other fields preserved; the Host's public `settingsSchema` resolves that leaf and validates the value before anything is sent; a duplicated user model id, an unconfirmed address or a read-only document stays read-only. A built-in model uses `modelOverrides` only when the route declares no models list and the id belongs to the installed catalog, and its inherited value is read from the base layer.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：`0.7.7` has passed type checks, builds, 103 model-reasoning behaviour checks and 29 palette browser checks. An isolated official npm DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` Web profile exercised the settings page, explicit mappings, invalid-save blocking, persistence after reopening and refresh, preservation of neighboring models, and draft conflicts across two Host changes. Normal-width and 390-pixel layouts were measured and their actual screenshots inspected after the corrections.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：This is combined coverage across stages. The final CSS changes received affected client type, build, load and layout checks; the 103 logic checks, 29 palette checks, save/conflict behaviour, unchanged backend, bilingual copy and first five logic suites reuse earlier passing results from this candidate. They were not all rerun in one window. Another 50 lifecycle checks used the actual rc.4 Cordis/module system/SlotRegistry and candidate factory, with controlled declaration changes and non-slot services; they do not establish end-to-end inline saving on a community Host.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：**0.7.7 is now a formal release.** These Web checks used synthetic models and do not certify native Electron, macOS, Windows or real model endpoints. The table above retains the separate historical 0.7.6 scope. See [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md) for retained failures, reused evidence and limits.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：`0.7.8` removed the standalone settings page introduced in 0.7.7. Hosts that declare `settings.models.model-fields` show the controls on the model card. Type checks, the build and 103 model-reasoning behaviour checks passed locally for this change. [Historical 0.7.7 settings page](docs/images/reasoning-model-settings-rc4.png).

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Host requirements and verification scope：`1.0.0` keeps the guidance frame at 312 × 360 pixels under normal conditions. Expanding guidance, long text and clipboard feedback do not resize it; small windows constrain it to the available area with internal scrolling. Agent briefs retain the target, endpoint-verification rules and suggested snippet without the repeated tutorial. Fallback-only logic, copy and tests have been removed.

**Desktop:** paste this fixed URL into Plugins → Add plugin. Check the version, enabled state and loading errors, then reload or restart as requested by the Host. Desktop owns its profile; a standalone CLI `web` profile does not update Desktop.

**Standalone Web/CLI profiles:** with DSH CLI installed:

```sh

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Install a fixed version：Replace `web` with your actual Web/CLI profile. The composition should include `id: reasoning-effort` and `name: '@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort'`; configuration presence alone does not prove active loading. Start or restart that profile and check its conversation model control. Do not enable the upstream package alongside this customization: their guidance channel and settings keys overlap.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Install a fixed version：Keep the previous tarball and current profile configuration before updating. Tarballs are fixed snapshots; pulling Git does not update an installed plugin.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Usage and capability semantics：The slider reads `reasoning.efforts` from the model directory. Maximum supported level, default level and current conversation choice are distinct. The Ultra label and top-level particles do not grant additional capability. Lowering and raising the configuration limit preserves existing draft mappings; sparse levels retain their actual endpoint values, and unrecognized mappings keep automatic mode available.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Usage and capability semantics：For a custom model without declarations, open View level declaration guidance. Follow the displayed configuration path and endpoint documentation to update the appropriate `llm-pi-ai` model entry, for example:

```yaml
reasoningEfforts:
  low: "<lower effort value accepted by the endpoint>"
  high: "<higher effort value accepted by the endpoint>"
```

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Usage and capability semantics：Unlisted levels are not declared as selectable. `reasoningEfforts: false` supplies no selectable effort levels; it does not guarantee that the endpoint performs no internal reasoning. Use `modelOverrides` for a single existing catalog model; a nonempty `models` list can replace the provider catalog.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Usage and capability semantics：Add `compat` fields such as `thinkingFormat`, `supportsReasoningEffort`, `supportsDeveloperRole` or `requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages` only when endpoint documentation or a specific error supports them. Built-in knowledge is advisory, not a vendor guarantee. A visible slider proves directory/UI recognition, not server acceptance of the parameters.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Usage and capability semantics：Copy for your agent places the model identity, real configuration path, diagnosis and starting snippet on the clipboard. It does not call another agent or apply changes automatically. Host guidance is read-only; inline model edits use the Host's existing save action. Custom `entries` can extend the knowledge base; see the [English configuration tutorial](src/client/agent-tutorial.en.md) and [Host configuration](src/index.ts).

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Disable, uninstall and retained data：- To restore the native model selector temporarily, turn off Reasoning effort slider in General Settings. This switch controls the slider entry; disable the Bundle in the plugin manager to stop the whole plugin.
- On Desktop, uninstall `@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort` through the same plugin manager. For a Web/CLI profile, use the exact scoped package name below, then restart or refresh the Host.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @missher/dsh-reasoning-effort
```

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Disable, uninstall and retained data：The plugin has no chat or learning database. It does not actively delete Host sessions, credentials, model declarations or other plugins' data on removal. Saved model settings remain Host-owned. It does not clear browser preferences `dsh-reasoning-effort.enabled` and `dsh-reasoning-effort.palette` (the legacy enabled key is also read); restarting after disabling restores the native entry. Back up custom `entries` and profile overrides before removal: their retention depends on the Host's uninstall operation. Do not delete an entire profile to reset appearance.

@missher/dsh-reasoning-effort README · Development and licenses：Use Node.js `22.19+` and pnpm `11.7.0`. In an isolated checkout, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm run check`, `pnpm test`, then `pnpm pack` sequentially. Test suites run serially. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md) and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Controls in the [design preview](design/depth-slider/README.md) are demonstrations; daily colours remain in Settings.
